title: Modulate Recognizer Options
description: Modulate-specific STT options. Only applies when recognizer vendor is 'modulate'. Modulate does not return confidence scores; transcripts are reported with confidence 1.0. The model is selected with the top-level recognizer 'model' property: 'velma-2-stt-streaming' (multilingual, the default) or 'velma-2-stt-streaming-english-v2' (low-latency English).

apiKey.description: Modulate API key. Overrides the key configured in jambonz.

endpointing.description: Only applies to model 'velma-2-stt-streaming-english-v2': emit a final transcript for each pause-delimited speech segment. Defaults to true in jambonz; set false to receive a single final transcript when the stream ends.

emotionSignal.description: Only applies to model 'velma-2-stt-streaming': detect the speaker's emotional tone for each utterance.

accentSignal.description: Only applies to model 'velma-2-stt-streaming': identify the speaker's accent for each utterance.

deepfakeSignal.description: Only applies to model 'velma-2-stt-streaming': score each utterance for synthetic (deepfake) voice likelihood.

piiPhiTagging.description: Only applies to model 'velma-2-stt-streaming': wrap detected PII/PHI in tags within the transcript text.

modulateSttUri.description: Custom host to connect to instead of platform.modulate.ai.

modulateSttUseTls.description: Use TLS when connecting to a custom host. Default true.
